name: arena-debate
description: Position-driven adversarial debate CLI — host supplies opposing stances, arena runs the debate across local model CLIs (Claude, Codex, Gemini, OpenAI, Kimi).
author: tim101010101

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "" 2>/dev/null; bun build src/index.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/index.js --minify && printf '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' | cat - dist/index.js > dist/index.tmp && mv dist/index.tmp dist/index.js && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.build:native: bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile=dist/arena-linux-x64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile=dist/arena-linux-arm64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile=dist/arena-darwin-x64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile=dist/arena-darwin-arm64
